key_insight: CurvDelta restricts model updates to a low-curvature space to learn or forget targeted capabilities while better preserving general capabilities.
engineering_relevance: It offers a preservation-aware approach to LLM adaptation, with K-FAC for scalable curvature approximation and CurvLoRA for more efficient low-rank updates.
method: Analyze local preservation-loss geometry around the pre-adaptation model.
Use K-FAC and factorized projection to construct low-curvature updates.
Apply CurvDelta or its low-rank variant, CurvLoRA, to learning and selective unlearning.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports competitive math and code performance with better capability retention, plus improved forgetting–retention balance on TOFU and MUSE, with retention close to from-scratch retraining.
watch_item: The preservation geometry is local and approximate, so large updates may require additional checks for capability degradation.
paper_title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
